Long-horizon routes

Four goals, each a branching tree: shared infrastructure forms the trunk, distinct theorem targets form the branches. Six major proof horizons remain, alongside statement targets and the open Zeeman conjecture. Click a tree node to locate its milestones in the full dependency map.

health = max(0, 100 − (3A + 4D + 3H + 6L + 8B + 12S + 5U)) A max observed round − 1 D distinct rubrics ever non-green H failed scope, API-design, generality, reuse or proof-quality rubrics L rubrics failing in multiple rounds B block rubric/round pairs U exact-head non-green rubrics S explicitly recorded scope/design resets
The SpinRep churn metric, not mathematical quality. Missing complete exact-head evidence is unscored, never 100. Merge/close marks use actual event times; open marks use the snapshot time.
